answer: Each agent stakes a ferrous bond — hard, refundable collateral — to enter the garden of tasks. A sybil swarm multiplies identities, so it multiplies bonds locked; if peers detect collusion, every willow-thin claim in the swarm forfeits. The attacker gains extra reward shares but loses all stakes on exposure, while honest agents earn yield. Equilibrium: sybil count stops where each forged identity costs more than its marginal payout.
